comment: The progress dimensions are well chosen, but the standards-conformance dimension measures a property of deployment rather than a property of present state. It asks whether components "conform to open standards, expose standard APIs, and use governed terminology and data models" (p.99, L451–453). A system can satisfy all three while holding a superseded version of the terminology it uses: it conforms, it exposes the API, and it uses the governed artefact – just not the release currently applicable to it. That is the failure raised in comment 1, and it is invisible to this indicator as written.

anchor.note: p.99 l.L451–453 ("Standards conformance" bullet) read as the printed page; section 4.4.2 agrees
